# NUS120 paired harness: bounded static review

Reviewed integrated `experiments/native_connected_pair_v1/{driver.py,run.py,
protocol.json,README.md}` and the relevant existing selected-routing,
preferences, candidate-copy, native-stage and publication helpers. Protocol
SHA256: `e1e4b96a4856a462eb5b1a2702fe64c57a122b73b228386b11ecd663da1842b6`.
All 49 prospective source pins match; every current autorouter source is covered.

No tests, Native, JVM, network, Git command, routing, source/data mutation or
recursive agents occurred. Only this excluded, on-Mac review directory is
written. Prior native positive/negative controls were not rerun in this pass.

## Required fix before routing: NC-PAIR1 (P1)

The outer supervisor's `stable()` (run.py:29-33) guards protocol/driver/wrapper
and only the inner result-file hash. After the actor exits, changing/removing
its final candidate, native report, selected child evidence, classifier sibling,
source companions or a pinned helper does not change that result-file hash.
Outer publication can consequently retain `method_qualified=true` for stale
materials. The actor's completed inventory is closure-only (driver.py:119), not
retained in its receipt; its classifier is also a sibling outside the actor's
output inventory. This is a concrete static late-freshness counterexample,
not an executed exploit.

Persist and check a narrow complete material witness through the outer final
callback: actor/child completed evidence, classifier sibling plus receipt,
original source, frozen code/tools. Reuse existing inventories/readers. The
wrapper must additionally require the inner receipt's exact kind/status/method/
protocol/accepted=false/within-budget/charged-caps identity, rather than trusting
`bool(inner.method_qualified)` alone. Regenerate a new prospective protocol after
this fix, before either arm runs. The finding was reported promptly to the lead.

## Other inspected gates

The fresh, independent classifier task is exactly the original with every
unprotected route/derived fill removed. Both arms bind it to captured all-six
or derived-five selected preferences; completion-only/both/native/source_all
and optimizer/fanout/neckdown guards are present. Accepted child full native
zero-opens checks and `p.check_result` are required. The actor copies the child
candidate exclusively, validates the copy against pristine originals/rules and
full schematic, binds saved/final reports and exact shell reconstruction, and
requires zero opens/blocking/exclusions plus unchanged fresh-original warning
signatures. It rechecks retained child evidence and metrics during publication.

Actor and supervisor start wall/full-CPU accounting before imports. The actor
charges its bootstrap allowance, reserves finalization time before assigning
the selected child, and pays its own classifier and all actual child/native
work. The outer runner separately measures complete delivery under 120-second
wall/full-CPU qualification; cancellation, timeout and failed methods remain
unqualified. These are acceptance caps, not a hard total-CPU OS quota.

No other concrete blocker was identified in this bounded pass. This does not
qualify routing, cancellation, equal-budget improvement, production admission,
or generalized superiority. The aggregate remains accepted=false; actual arms
and final independent evidence readback remain lead-owned.

## Focused fix reread: NC-PAIR1 statically closed

The lead's revised driver retains `completed_material` for actor/child evidence
and `classifier_material` plus the classifier receipt pin for its sibling.
`check_outer_witness` requires exact typed identity/method/protocol/cap fields,
finite raw/charged budget algebra, both material inventories, original source,
and unchanged complete tool/code witnesses. The wrapper invokes that helper
through its stability checks and final publication callback whenever qualified.
It also retains the actor receipt hash. Actor accounting now samples wall/full
CPU once before adding the fixed allowance, avoiding inconsistent duplicate
sampling in the exact arithmetic check.

Reviewed revised driver SHA256:
`1104048cd48a1f73b9ce012469b75d552dddfa372fec03ea73b64b24b0c3a6af`;
wrapper SHA256:
`dd9f277dddd11309a6e9b2f8435b9dda91958b314db7e27c712a408a98578f0b`.
No additional concrete blocker was found in this focused static pass. Tests were
not run by this reviewer. The old protocol above still pins the earlier files;
the lead must regenerate/freeze prospective driver/wrapper/protocol pins before
either arm. No arm has been executed as part of this review.

resource_guards.limitations: Polling can overshoot; group RSS can double-count shared pages and miss peaks; workdir logical sizes exclude symlinks and stop counting after the bound is crossed.

resource_accounting.cpu_scope: direct child plus descendants accounted for by child wait
resource_accounting.rss_scope: kernel peak, not simultaneous process-tree total
resource_accounting.monitor_cpu_scope: macOS libproc is included in parent CPU; other-platform ps helper CPU is monitor_cpu_seconds

full_integration.scope: Full integration of prospective paired harness after NC-PAIR1 outer material continuity correction; filesystem controls do not prove Native routing. Prior core Native proof unchanged; pair not executed.

controls: 22 targeted classifier/pair controls pass; actual tempfile nested candidate/report/child/classifier/source/helper mutation/removal and typed identity/cap rejection. Metadata isolation mocks tool_manifest only; no Native pass simulated. Full0531120software controls pass. NC-PAIR1 closed before either arm.
pending: Both sequential120wall/fullCPU arms, actual original-rule/full-schematic final checks and independent readback. No routing improvement established.
